up: Retrieve all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1133022. For each such molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID (from the molecule dictionary), preferred name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Return each distinct molecule only once, even if it appears in multiple records within that document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133022' AND cr.molregno IS NOT NULL;
